summary: Retested backend + frontend regression for strict CORS, auth/me 204 behavior, Intuition & Channeling Atlas content, global search, methods labels, responsive overflow, and build/pytest health. Application-layer CORS is strict on localhost; public preview OPTIONS is still wildcard at ingress.

critical.issue: Ingress/proxy still returns access-control-allow-origin: * for both allowed and malicious origins, masking strict FastAPI app-layer CORS behavior.

integration_issues.issue: Browser-facing preflight behavior is controlled upstream and does not reflect strict backend allowlist behavior.

action_items: Escalate preview ingress CORS override to platform support; app code cannot force strict preflight if OPTIONS is intercepted upstream.
Keep strict app-layer CORS regression tests against localhost:8001 as guardrails.
Optionally make data-testid values globally unique where duplicated (premium-status-pill appears in two conditional nodes).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py correctly derives APP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS only from APP_ALLOWED_HOSTS and does not read CORS_ORIGINS for middleware setup.
AuthContext uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and guest auth/me now cleanly handles 204 without console noise in tested run.
One duplicate data-testid exists (premium-status-pill) across conditional link/button variants in SiteShell; low-risk but not globally unique.
test_credentials: Used seeded session tokens from /app/memory/test_credentials.md: test_session_shane_free_2026 and test_session_shane_premium_2026.
seed_data_creation: Regression tests created/updated test subscriber and member test records via API calls.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 30 backend pytest checks passed after aligning guest auth expectation to 204 and routing strict CORS assertions to localhost app-layer. Public preview still shows wildcard CORS on OPTIONS (ingress-level). UI checks passed for /knowledge/intuitive (10 abilities, 4 lenses, 4 channeler profiles, discernment + safety), /knowledge world + global search (clairvoyance/channeling), and /methods state labels with desktop/mobile overflow=0.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: OPTIONS to preview URL returns 204 with access-control-allow-origin:* for both allowed and malicious origins. OPTIONS to localhost:8001 returns strict expected behavior (allowed origin echoed with credentials=true, malicious origin 400/no allow-origin). Root cause is upstream ingress/proxy CORS interception/override, not FastAPI middleware. Mitigation: platform-side CORS policy change for preview ingress; keep app-layer strict tests to prevent backend regressions.
